title: Expressive Register and Affective Stylistics: Kosztolányi's Poetics

sections.title: Philosophical & Societal Framework
sections.content: Dezső Kosztolányi was a poet and novelist who also wrote many essays about the Hungarian language; a collection of them appeared as *Nyelv és lélek* (Language and Soul). He wrote about words as if they had weight, temperature, scent and a melody (*dallamosság*).

sections.title: Linguistic Analysis
sections.content: In 1933 the newspaper *Pesti Hírlap* asked him for the ten most beautiful Hungarian words, and he named, half in play: *láng, gyöngy, anya, ősz, szűz, kard, csók, vér, szív, sír*. Notice that none of them is abstract; nine of the ten have one syllable, and all name something physical or felt.
